ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your account is suspended or inactive. Contact HR.
TENANT_INACTIVE: Your company's subscription is inactive. Contact HR.
DEVICE_NOT_BOUND: This device is not linked to your account. Request a device change in the app.
ATTESTATION_FAILED: We couldn't verify the app or device integrity. Update the app and retry.
NO_AUTHORIZED_SITE: You have no authorized work site at this time.
SEQUENCE_INVALID: There is no open clock-in to clock out from.
LOC_INSIDE: You are inside the work site.
LOC_OUTSIDE: You are outside the work site.
LOC_UNCERTAIN: We couldn't confirm you are inside the site. Sent for review.
LOC_LOW_ACCURACY: Location accuracy is low. Move near a window or the entrance and retry.
LOC_NO_VALID_SAMPLE: Couldn't get a recent location. Please retry.
LOC_APPROXIMATE_PERMISSION: Enable 'Precise Location' for this app in Settings, then retry.
RISK_MOCK_LOCATION: A simulated location was detected. Sent for review.
RISK_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: The device failed the integrity check. Sent for review.
RISK_IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL: The distance from your last punch isn't possible in this time. Sent for review.
RISK_CLOCK_SKEW: Your device clock differs from server time. Server time was used.
RISK_SHARED_DEVICE: This device was used for more than one account. Sent for review.
RISK_LOCATION_ACCESSORY: Location came from an external accessory.
RISK_SAMPLE_INCONSISTENT: Location readings were inconsistent. Sent for review.
RISK_ACCURACY_IMPLAUSIBLE: Reported accuracy is unusual for this site.
RISK_WIFI_UNKNOWN_AT_SITE: Wi-Fi network is unknown for this site.
RISK_REMOTE_CONTROL_APP: A remote-control app was detected. Sent for review.
RISK_HIGH_DEVICE_ACTIVITY: Unusual device activity. Sent for review.
RISK_BOOT_UNVERIFIED: The device OS is not verified. Sent for review.
SUP_WIFI_KNOWN: Connected to the branch's known network.
SUP_PROVIDER_GNSS: Location from GPS with good accuracy.
OFFLINE_EXPIRED: The offline punch is older than allowed.
AUTH_MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED: Two-factor authentication must be set up for this role.
AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
AUTH_REFRESH_REUSED: Your session was ended for security reasons. Please sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission for this action.
ACTIVATION_CODE_INVALID: The activation code is invalid, expired, or already used.
DEVICE_ALREADY_BOUND: This device is linked to another account.
DEVICE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_APPROVAL: You already have a linked device. Submit a device change request for HR approval.
DEVICE_CHANGE_NOT_OPEN: The device change request is not open.
DEVICE_CHANGE_SELF_APPROVAL: You can't approve your own device change request.
DEVICE_CHANGE_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open device change request.
BINDING_INVALID_TRANSITION: This action can't change the device link status.
